name: The announcer
about: The overhaul's announcer (spec #216, EH9 #225): one voice with the 1987 ROM's ROUND 1 / FIGHT!, calling the era call-outs and finished combos. Designed from a description, never cloned.

design.description: A ringside announcer at a 1980s world fighting tournament. Adult man, strong mid-range voice, a little gravel, loud and bright. He barks single words and short phrases with hard consonants, as if he's calling the action over a crowd through a cheap PA. No breathiness, no long vowels, no commentary.
design.description_from: docs/design/2026-11-04-era-hud-and-callouts-design.md, The announcer (agreed in grilling, 2026-11-04, tuned toward the 1987 voice that says ROUND 1 and FIGHT!)
design.preview_text: ROUND ONE! FIGHT! SUPER! PERFECT! COUNTER! PUNISH COUNTER! REVERSAL! FIRST ATTACK! PERFECT PARRY! ALPHA COUNTER! CRUSH COUNTER! BURNOUT! CUSTOM COMBO! FIVE HIT COMBO! TWELVE HIT COMBO!
